programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Fifteen-year-old Madisen says she wants desperately for a place to belong and has made terrible choices in an attempt to do just that. She claims to have already joined a gang, gotten pregnant and hit a teacher. Everyone, even Madisen, agrees she is troubled, but why does Dr. Phil say it would’ve been a bigger surprise if she didn't turn out this way? Did her father really try to forfeit his parental rights? And did her mother turn a blind eye to so many red flags? Learn why Dr. Phil believes it’s not too late for this teen.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Madisen first appeared on Dr. Phil her family had reached a breaking point with her defiant and outrageous behavior. Months later, after completing her program at a residential treatment facility for troubled teens, Madisen returns to the Dr. Phil stage to show off her amazing transformation. The 15-year-old says she’s ready to return home, but is home ready for her?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In this powerful program, Dr. Phil exposes the frightening yet underreported problem of mothers on the verge on committing child abuse. We meet ordinary women who live in fear that they’re going to hurt their children in a fit of uncontrollable rage. Chrystel says she feels rage and snaps and then it gets to the point where there's no return. Jessica says her fits of rage become so intense, she's scared that she will hurt her son. Answering their desperate pleas for help, Dr. Phil explains how to identify cues leading up to this precarious state, and tells moms what to do when they start to lose control.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In this powerful program, Dr. Phil once again exposes the frightening yet underreported problem of mothers on the verge of committing child abuse. We meet ordinary women who live with the fear that they’re going to hurt their children in a fit of uncontrollable rage. Joanna says her rage is scaring her son. Michelle’s rage has driven her to slap her child and hit her with a wooden spoon. Lisa admits to pulling her daughter’s hair when she gets angry. Answering their desperate pleas for help, Dr. Phil explains how to identify cues leading up to this precarious state, and tells moms what to do when they start to lose control.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Mom to Blame for Babies' Death?
programme.desc: A man accuses his ex-wife and her new husband of killing his children.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his interview with Tommy, who accuses his ex-wife, Julia, and her new husband, Codey, of killing his 19-month-old son, Darby, and 4-year-old stepdaughter, Kiera -- an allegation the couple vehemently deny. Dr. Phil enlists the help of forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht to examine the children’s autopsy reports -- what are his findings? And, will Julia and Codey agree to take polygraph tests?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Ex Puts Fame Before Our Daughter
programme.desc: A couple is battling for custody of their 10-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with husband and wife, Nathan and April, who claim a woman named Ashley is fixated on their beautiful twin daughters.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his work with The Dr. Phil Family, an out-of-control, angry group with a long history of infidelities, betrayals and bitter resentments. Melissa’s boyfriend, Randy, joins the family at The Dr. Phil House, but Gene and Myra are not happy to see him. They think that Randy is a liar and a thief, and the reason Melissa has gained about 100 pounds in the last five years. Gene and Myra attempt to talk to Melissa about her weight, but Melissa is anything but receptive. Then, because they often blame each other for the chaos in the family, Melissa and Gene are assigned to bury the hatchet long enough to cook a family dinner together, without help from anyone else. Will these relatives be able to follow the rules? After dinner, a family meeting turns heated with accusations and tearful confessions. Dr. Phil joins the family and confronts Melissa and Randy about their sometimes violent relationship and Melissa’s mismanagement of her health. Can this couple create a nurturing relationship for the sake of their autistic child? Will Melissa do what it takes to gain control over her weight?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After all their hard work, the latest Dr. Phil Family receives some surprises from Dr. Phil! He informs Melissa that everything she needs to get her life back on track is headed her way: a complete health evaluation, personal trainer, nutritionist, and food service delivered to her door. In addition, she’ll receive help for her depression and be connected with a developmental disabilities specialist for her autistic son. But it all comes with a condition: Melissa and Randy need to heal their toxic relationship. Then, a talk with Myra and Gene leads to a tearful apology. And, will a one-on-one with Dr. Phil’s wife, Robin, help Myra see that she deserves to be treated with dignity and respect? Will Myra set some standards in her broken marriage? Will there even be a marriage to speak of when they get home? Dr. Phil has some strong words for Gene. Next, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity pits brother against brother as Edwin and Eugene audition for a Hollywood talent agent and a casting director. Don’t miss the surprising twist when they get a call from the judges. Then, it’s time to switch gears – literally! Since Myra and Melissa never learned to drive, Dr. Phil sets them up with a driving lesson so they can become more independent. And you won’t believe the prize in store for the women if they pass their driver’s test! Dr. Phil sits down with the entire family one last time. Will they use the tools he gave them to build healthier relationships?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Recently, parents across America were googling “Who is Andrew Tate?” making him number three in Google searches for 2022, right behind Queen Elizabeth and Donald Trump. Tate claims to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. However, in August 2022, Tate was banned on social media for his misogynist viewpoints. Twenty-four-year-old Ben says when he was a teen, he had zero self-esteem, never got past the first date, and felt powerless with girls. He tells Dr. Phil that men like Tate inspired him to break out of his shell -- and he shares how. Then, a healthy debate about “toxic masculinity” with the “Godfather of the Manosphere," a scholar and author, a men’s rights attorney, and the CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Andrew Tate is known for his misogynistic social media posts and videos claiming to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. Tate is fighting a legal battle in Romania right now, but should parents worry about his influence on their sons? Before Tate was detained, Dr. Phil spoke with Richard Reeves, senior fellow at the Brookings Institute and author “Of Boys and Men: Why the Modern Male is Struggling, Why it Matters, and What to Do about It”; Marilyn York, a men’s rights attorney; Imran Ahmed, CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate; and blogger and author Rollo Tomassi. Plus, hear from a group of teenage boys who surprise their mothers when they share what they think about Tate. And, Robin joins the conversation.

programme.title: Dr. Phil Primetime
programme.sub-title: Below NYC with Mayor Eric Adams (Pt. 2)
programme.desc: Dr. Phil joins NYC Mayor Eric Adams on an evening tour of Herald Square and West 4th Street subway stations to explore the PATH initiative, which offers resources to help homeless and mentally ill individuals transition off the streets.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Dad Was The Breast Pump Bandit (Part 1)
programme.desc: Lauren says she resents her parents, Laura and John, claiming that as a teen, Laura stole her identity and racked up $50,000 in debt – a claim Laura denies – and that John had affairs on her mom and drank alcohol and used drugs with her and her teenage friends. John admits he was the “party dad,” but claims he was just trying to bond with Lauren. But is this just the tip of the iceberg? Dr. Phil drops the bombshell that John spent nearly two years behind bars and was dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news. It’s a Dr. Phil episode you cannot miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nicky, 17, says she loves to fight and proudly posts the videos of the brawls on the Internet. The teen brags that she once cracked a girl’s head on the concrete, has broken cheekbones and noses, and has had so many confrontations, she's lost count. She says the police have been called to her home as many as 80 times, and she’s been arrested monthly since she was 13 years old. What’s at the root of her rage? Dr. Phil delves deep into Nicky’s past to find the source of her pain. And, Nicky’s mom, Yvette, says she feels helpless and fears her daughter will end up dead or in prison, but is she modeling bad behavior? An anonymous letter to the show makes shocking allegations against Yvette. Can Dr. Phil get this family help -- before someone gets really hurt -- or worse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Levi and Bob say their once-perfect, honor roll student, Tiffani, has changed into someone they don’t know, and she is terrorizing the family. Levi says the 15-year-old is mean and evil, drinks, steals and fights with her every day. In one altercation, Levi says Tiffani spit in her face, punched her and threatened to push her off a balcony, and now she’s afraid for her life. Bob says Tiffani doesn’t respect discipline or any authority -- including the police. Tiffani has been in juvenile detention three times, and Bob says each time she's released, her behavior only escalates. Dr. Phil takes a look into their family dynamics. How might Bob and Levi be contributing to Tiffani's recklessness? Plus, hear from Tiffani. You may be surprised to hear why she says she acts out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Wake-Up Call for the Nation Pt 1
programme.desc: As the nation reels from the intense pressure of the 2020 Election, Dr. Phil welcomes broadcaster, journalist, and author Piers Morgan, whose latest book, Wake Up, is all about our divided society in the wake of COVID-19, the BLM protests, and the controversy surrounding the presidential election. Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.title: Christmas Keepsake

The two tasks themselves with finding its owner which leads them to finding love and their own perfect family Christmas.

programme.title: Christmas at Fields Ranch

Focused on selling, she returns home only to reconnect with Ben, her childhood crush who now works as a ranch hand. As holiday traditions stir memories and rekindle old feelings, Daisy begins to question the fast-paced career she’s built. With the season drawing to a close, she must decide between ambition and love.

programme.title: Christmas on the Ranch
programme.desc: A big-city relationship expert, famous for dishing out advice on her hit talk show, finds her carefully curated life unraveling when she gets stranded at a small-town ranch just before Christmas. Forced to trade cameras and cue cards for chores and quiet nights, she clashes—and sparks—with the rugged rancher who takes her in. As holiday magic weaves around them, she learns that love, unpolished and unscripted, could be her most life-changing lesson.

programme.title: Exes of Christmas Past
programme.desc: An ambitious hotel manager returns to her hometown for Christmas, planning only a short visit at her family’s charming B&B. To her surprise, the inn is booked solid—with her three high school exes among the guests. As old rivalries resurface and sparks fly, she’s swept into a holiday whirlwind of laughter, mishaps, and second chances. Amid the festive chaos, she discovers love may have been waiting all along.

programme.title: A Merry Single Christmas
programme.desc: Morgan has lost her Christmas spirit after breaking up with her long time boyfriend, Liam. She decides to go to a retreat called The Christmas Lonely Hearts Club where she hopes to rekindle her Christmas spirit. Things seem to be going well until her Ex shows up. Morgan and Liam will have to conceal their previous relationship while trying to discover what it means to be single. What they don’t realize is that adhering to the “no romance” policy might require a Christmas miracle.

programme.title: Christmas on Repeat
programme.desc: An ad executive, overwhelmed by work, is granted a magical do-over of the holidays by Santa. As she relives the same festive days, she begins to recognize how much time she’s missed with her family. Through the repeating moments, she learns to slow down, cherish loved ones, and find balance between career and personal life. The story highlights the importance of connection, presence, and appreciating the people who matter most.

programme.title: A Christmas Cruise
programme.desc: A single, successful writer decides to do double duty when her best friend invites her on a Christmas Cruise and decides to see if finding true love during the holidays can really happen or will it be just another holiday story.

In an attempt to escape the embarrassment, she and her best friend Liam fake their own holiday romance…but when her fake feelings for Liam start to turn real, Ashley will have to choose what her heart really wants this Christmas.

programme.title: Dognapped: Hound for the Holidays

As the two investigate all possible suspects, the duo form an unbreakable relationship that just might lead them to become more than partners as they find their own puppy love.

programme.title: The Search for Secret Santa

programme.title: The Case of the Christmas Diamond

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.sub-title: Unscripted Paranormal: Hell's Tunnel & Prince Memorial
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society explore the remnants of a tunnel system once used by an asylum and prison, now known as “Hell’s Tunnel” due to its reported paranormal activity and then, the team embarks on a heartfelt investigation to reach out to the spirit of Prince in Henderson, Minnesota.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society dig into the urban legend of the "Lantern Man" in Le Sueur, Minnesota. Known locally as the "Brewery Hill Spook Light," the figure is rumored to walk the railroad tracks at night with a lantern. Adrian not only confirms the existence of the apparition but also reveals its identity and the reasons it haunts this area.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society investigate a suspected haunting in an old multi-use church. However, the investigation takes an unexpected emotional turn as they connect with a surprising spirit. What begins as a typical haunting becomes deeply personal, and the team moves from assumption to affirmation—all caught on camera.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society venture underground to investigate the caves beneath Jordan Brewery in Jordan, Minnesota. In this unique paranormal investigation, the team encounters a mysterious "non-human" presence and captures stunning visual evidence deep within the caves.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.sub-title: Unscripted Paranormal: The Crazy Annie Story
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society dive into the urban legend of “Crazy Annie” in Henderson, Minnesota. The chilling tale tells of a grieving woman who drowned her children and hanged herself after her husband died in WWI. The team uncovers how much of this tragic story is rooted in fact and how much is pure fiction.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.sub-title: Unscripted Paranormal: The Litchfield Opera House
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society investigate the historic Litchfield Opera House in Litchfield, Minnesota. While exploring the location, the team makes contact with two iconic Hollywood performers, Mary Angell and Gale Sondergaard, and captures a full-bodied apparition on thermal camera.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.sub-title: Unscripted Paranormal: A Night in Red Wing
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society conduct three investigations across Red Wing, Minnesota, including a stop at what Adrian calls “one of the most haunted locations he’s ever seen” in the basement of Liberty’s Restaurant. They also investigate the Sea Wing disaster memorial and the Red Wing train depot.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society explore the site of a 1933 shootout between the Barrow gang and police near Dexter, Iowa. Though Bonnie and Clyde escaped, the confrontation left Buck Barrow critically wounded and his wife Blanche in police custody. The team investigates lingering spirits from this infamous shootout.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society investigate Green Lawn Cemetery in Southwest Minnesota, a site notorious for teenage “dares” and urban legends. What they uncover is much deeper than anticipated, revealing historical significance alongside paranormal activity.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society head to Music Row in Nashville, Tennessee for an epic season finale. The investigation spans four iconic locations, starting at the graves of Keith Whitley and Johnny Cash, and ending with an exploration of the Nashville Musicians Association union hall and the world-famous Sound Emporium Studios.

programme.desc: Alexander the Great transformed Alexandria from a village into a thriving city with remarkable urban design.

programme.title: The Miracle of Tonya Pinkins
programme.desc: A musical biographical documentary about the life, times and career of Tony Award winner and Broadway performing star Tonya Pinkins (Jelly’s Last Jam, Play On, Caroline or Change) the movie chronicles her beginning as a professional child actress in Chicago to an award winning Broadway star, along with the stories and songs that made her one of America’s top performing artists.

programme.title: The Princess Killers
programme.desc: Two friends take a chance to change their lives and become partners in the world of crime, and build reputations as strong, no nonsense, business women. They soon discover it’s lonely at the top, when their enemies close in on them, while maintaining their own friendship.

programme.title: New Year New Us 2: #LoveGoals
programme.desc: On a mission to maintain a successful marriage in a city full of temptation, Bakari & Imani are trying their best to get on the same page. But just when things seem to be getting back on track, secrets and lies threaten to tear down everything they've built.

programme.title: Tilt
programme.desc: When a local drug dealer is arrested and put in jail, he asks his daughter Diamond to run his operation. Diamond takes control of the empire, however it doesn’t sit well with members of the crew. Diamond gets word, from her trusted sources, that two members of the crew are plotting to overthrow her Father’s drug empire. Diamond must get rid of the two disloyal members of the crew before they take control of the operation.

programme.title: The Co-Signer
programme.desc: Released from prison, Mark makes the decision to change his ways. Kane has other plans in store for him.

programme.title: The Break of Dawn
programme.desc: After leaving an abusive relationship, college student Dawn Monae discovers that her ex has committed suicide. After some time, she meets a man named Keith online, but her roommates suspect that he isn’t who he says he is. Little do they know, he has an agenda that no one saw coming.

programme.title: Dirty Thirty
programme.desc: Naomi Turner is celebrating her 30th birthday with family and friends. A night full of alcohol and drugs leads to a hangover the next morning with no memory of the night before. Soon they find out that Naomi is missing. As her husband Justin is searching for an answer, he finds out nothing but secrets, lies and Naomi’s dead body. Justin is the prime suspect and has to prove his innocence while he searches for who killed his wife.

programme.title: Don't Push That
programme.desc: Three friends who all work together at a local video store stumble upon a mysterious device labeled “DPT” which has a mysterious function: predicting the absolute worst possible outcome of any moment or decision. Once the button on the device is pressed, the action can’t be undone, and it must be repeated every 11 minutes to prevent further destruction. The results are equally fun and chaotic.

programme.title: The Sermon
programme.desc: When a charismatic pastor’s sermons begin to influence a group of men searching for purpose, their actions evolve into a series of calculated crimes carried out in the name of righteousness.

programme.title: The Other Sister
programme.desc: After ending her relationship to focus on her future, a driven young woman invites her troubled sister to move in for a fresh start. But as boundaries begin to blur, jealousy turns into obsession, and trust quickly unravels. When secrets come to light, she must confront a chilling truth. Sometimes the biggest threat isn’t a stranger. It’s family.

programme.title: It's Complicated AF
programme.desc: After an intense romance, Ryan and Quaves make the crazy decision to get married without having met in person. But as friends and family gather in Houston for a whirlwind wedding weekend, everything spirals into chaos as the bridal party clashes over secret agendas, bruised egos, and a stolen parking spot. A romantic comedy about fate, bad timing, and the kind of love that refuses to show up quietly.

programme.title: The Shining Star of Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of one of America’s favorite actors, Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs (Welcome Back Kotter, The Jacksons: An American Dream, Claudine, Cooley High). In fascinating form, Mr. Hilton Jacobs takes us on his life’s journey from his childhood beginning in Harlem, New York to the bright lights of the Broadway Stage and on to becoming a Hollywood movie and television star.

Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 10, Finland Lightweight World Championship
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: From now on every stage of these series will be more than crucial. Curacao is a beautiful Dutch island in the Caribbean, with a great atmosphere to hold another stage of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Let’s see who takes the title here and who will secure a place in the next stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ten of the world’s strongest men gathered in Amman to compete in Jordan’s first-ever Truck-Pull Championship. The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World’s Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Taking place in Corinth, Greece, considered by many the cradle of the sports competition games, an epic strongman battle will mark the last stage before the upcoming big two-day season’s finale in Chetumal, Mexico. In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 15, Mexico World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 16, Mexico World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances – and even world records!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 1, Norway - World Strongest Viking
programme.desc: Season 2018 begins with 14 strongest men in the world, all competing for the title. The competition kicks off in Norway. We’ll see typical Viking disciplines, team events and world records in heavy conditions in the land of snow and ice. They will suffer, they will freeze and fight in this first competition of the year for the title that they will carry on their shoulders throughout whole year.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver's heirloom watch is broken so he tries to find his ex-secretary Carol's address to ask her the name of the jeweler who fixed it last time. Carol is now working and living in Los Angeles, and we get a glimpse into her new life.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: In this classic series' premiere episode, New York City attorney Oliver Wendell Douglas (Eddie Albert) satisfies his desire for the simple life by buying a farm, much to the chagrin of his wife, Lisa (Eva Gabor). John Charles Daly narrates the tale!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Lisa's First Day On The Farm
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) brings his wife, Lisa (Eva Gabor), to their new home, a ramshackle farm near Hooterville, just outside of Pixley, where she gets to meet the town's oddball residents. Bea Benaderet, Edgar Buchanan and Frank Cady guest star!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) is ready to get farming, but Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts her foot down and says she will leave unless they can hire a decorator to fix the house! Meanwhile, Kate Bradley (Bea Benaderet) teaches Lisa how to make "hotscakes."

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Is the Honeymoon period over already? The rumor mill has it that Lisa (Eva Gabor) has packed up and left Oliver (Eddie Albert). Actually, she went back to New York to close up their penthouse apartment. And Mr. Haney is up to his old tricks!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) calls in a roofer, a plumber and agricultural expert Hank Kimball (Alvy Moore). All of them give the same appraisal of his farm: it's a disaster! Meanwhile, Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) has a few chickens he'd like to rent out!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The Douglases are awaiting the arrival of their furniture and they don't know it, but Oliver's mother is on her way, too. But when the furniture is accidentally delivered to Mr. Haney's new place, he tries to sell their own possession back to them.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Planting season ends in three weeks and Oliver has yet to get his land plowed. Meanwhile, Uncle Joe (Edgar Buchanan) needs a new shotgun before duck hunting season starts and schemes to solve both of their problems...without Oliver knowing it.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver (Eddie Albert) sends a sample of his soil to the State Scientific College, a report comes back that his farm contains ingredients never before found in soil. Could his soil problems just be cosmetic? Eleanor Audley guest stars.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: You Can't Plug In A 2 With A 6
programme.desc: Relying on statistics provided by the Department of Agriculture, Oliver (Eddie Albert) decides to plant wheat. But when he goes to Drucker's to buy seed, he learns the other farmers have a unique way to predict the best crop�Mrs. Ziffel's lumbago.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Don't Call Us, We'll Call You
programme.desc: After some wheeling and dealing and mending a riff between Mr. Kimball and his mother, Oliver (Eddie Albert) finally has a phone installed, but the Hooterville Phone Company installs it directly outside his bedroom window...on top of the phone pole.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) plants his entire 160 acres with wheat, only to hear from The Crabwell Corners Conservation and Stabilization Committee, a local farm organization, that he was only permitted to grow eight acres of wheat�because of Mr. Haney.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The cow that Oliver (Eddie Albert) bought from Mr. Haney is pregnant. Afraid that Haney will claim the new calf, Oliver and Eb decide to keep it secret...only to have the people of Hooterville think that it is Lisa (Eva Gabor) who is expecting!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's the Douglases' wedding anniversary and, after initially pretending not to remember, Oliver (Eddie Albert) makes clear that he knows the date very well, he just can't remember exactly how many years he and Lisa (Eva Gabor) have been married.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is shocked that Hooterville has no beauty parlor, and the Ladies' Every-Other-Wednesday Afternoon-Discussion-Club nominates her to make it happen. Of course, Oliver's mother is happy to help, even if it means underhanded tactics.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Give Me Land, Lots Of Land
programme.desc: When Oliver's neighbor, Mr. Watson, decides to do some traveling, Oliver (Eddie Albert) buys the farm which adjoins his property, but not the house on it. Lisa (Eva Gabor) misunderstands and thinks the beautiful farmhouse is their new home.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: I Didn't Raise My Husband To Be A Fireman
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers the only requirement to join the Hooterville Valley Fire Department is that he must play a musical instrument. Meanwhile Lisa (Eva Gabor) tries her hand at cooking something besides "hotscakes" for breakfast.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Believing he will never get a moment's peace, Oliver (Eddie Albert) is annoyed when Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts a listing in the new phone book: "Oliver Douglas, Attorney at Law"�but it is a different story when no one calls for his services.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert)'s apple crop is ready to be harvested, and he decides to take them to market himself and make a killing. Of course, getting to market before the price drops proves a little more difficult than Oliver anticipates.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) becomes enamored of Mr. Kimball (Alvy Moore), the county agent. However, though she feminizes herself and gets all gussied up, he refuses to go out with a girl named Ralph. Can Oliver solve the situation legally?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Six months is up! Now, Lisa (Eva Gabor) gets to decide whether she and Oliver (Eddie Albert) will remain on the farm or go back to New York and their Park Avenue lifestyle! Will this be the final straw for Green Acres?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Sam Drucker (Frank Cady) is leaving on a much-needed two-week vacation and talks Oliver (Eddie Albert) into assuming his duties as deputy sheriff. But Oliver soon learns enforcing the law isn't quite as easy as it looks.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Whatever you do, don't say her name and especially while playing checkers down at Drucker's! An old hag named Molly Turgiss (Renie Riano), who died twenty years before the Douglases (Eddie Albert, Eva Gabor) came to town, might be haunting them.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Never Look A Gift Tractor In The Mouth
programme.desc: It's a few days before Oliver (Eddie Albert)'s birthday, and Lisa (Eva Gabor) doesn't know quite what to get him�until the old Hoyt Clagwell goes kerflooey! So, she goes out and buys the biggest and fanciest tractor she can find.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Eb (Tom Lester) has a way with sick animals after Eb cures Arnold, the pig, and Alice, the chicken, and offers to put him through veterinary college. But will life in Green Acres ever be the same without Ed?!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: A horse follows Oliver (Eddie Albert) home, but every time he tries to show it to his wife, the horse disappears. Lisa (Eva Gabor) assumes that her husband is imagining things�and as more animals show up, Oliver begins to think so too.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) takes Oliver (Eddie Albert) to Pixley Superior Municipal Court and sues him for non-payment of a vital contract over the little matter of some rain�or lack thereof. Does Mr. Haney know who he's up against? Does Oliver?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The Third-Tuesday-of-Every-Month-Culture-Committee of the Every-Other-Wednesday-Afternoon-Discussion-Club decides that Hooterville needs some "culture" in the form of a symphony orchestra. And Lisa (Eva Gabor) may just know the perfect conductor.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver's (Eddie Albert) nephew Charles (Don Edmonds) arrives for a visit, and Oliver is completely shaken up when the boy turns out to be a long-haired, motorcycle-ridin', hippy-dippy type. But, boy, does he know a thing or two about engines.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver dreams of entering his crop in the Corn Festival, but the dreaded "Bing Bug" invades Hooterville's farms. After learning of his service as a WWII pilot, the locals volunteer him for the perilous task of flying the town's only crop duster.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: How To See South America By Bus
programme.desc: When a lovely, young and successful farmer comes to Oliver (Eddie Albert) for his legal counsel, Lisa (Eva Gabor) quickly becomes jealous of the two spending time together and becomes determined to break up what she sees as a budding romance.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When the Monroe Brothers show up to fix the Douglas's closet, Lisa learns that Ralph is devastated because her true love has stood her up on another date. Lisa's solution: an intensive, two-day beauty treatment for Ralph�and the barn for Oliver!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: One Of Our Assemblymen Is Missing
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) takes to his soap box, delivering fiery, patriotic speeches after getting a bill from the State Farm Unattached Duty Tax for an outrageous $12.03! But no one can figure out why the tax is levied in the first place.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is curious to learn about the book that Oliver (Eddie Albert) is reading. It is the "real-life" story of pioneers Gus and Etta Thompson. The episode flashes back to the 19th century with Oliver appearing as Gus and Lisa as Etta.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Eb Discovers The Birds And The Bees
programme.desc: Eb (Tom Lester) seeks dating advice from the Douglas's after laying eyes on former classmate Betty Jo Bradley from "petticoat Junction." Oliver's well-intentioned guidance has mixed results when Eb hilariously misconstrues the advice he's given.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The locals complain that Oliver's penchant for wearing business suits to do farm work is ruining Hooterville's image. Oliver tries to adjust, but the last laugh is on him when Lisa has her dressmaker design Italian him some swanky new overalls.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: You Ought To Be In Pictures

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Home Isn't Built In A Day
programme.desc: Fed up with the house being in dire need of repair, Lisa demands that Oliver arrange to have the house redone or she's moving back to New York. Oliver agrees, but is delayed when Mr. Haney claims that their farmhouse is a historic monument.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Everything is topsy-turvy and henhouse hijinks ensue when one of the Douglas' hens is found to be laying square eggs! News of this kind gets around quickly, and the townsfolk all get in on the race to capitalize on the impressive novelty.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is absolutely determined to have a truly old-fashioned Christmas, including decorating his own farm-grown tree. But warm weather stands in the way and, he discovers, the residents of Hooterville aren't exactly as traditional as he thought.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Never Trust A Little Old Lady
programme.desc: In true Hooterville fashion, Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that the town is vehemently split as to which weather reporter they trust. As debates rage over which forecast is correct, Oliver plants his tomato crop, hoping for the best.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After another disastrous effort from Lisa in the kitchen, Oliver implores her to take a home economics class at the local high school. Before she knows it, Lisa is a fully enrolled student...the likes of which Hooterville High has never quite seen.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Judy Justice

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: After 'kidnapping' her own child from a family member and evading police, a woman is charged with child endangerment and spends four months in jail. She accuses her mother of stealing thousands from her while she was imprisoned.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Festival Drug Business and Step-Father Car Fiasco
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman loans 10K to a new friend to support his supplement business; he claims it was an investment in a plan to sell 'happy pills' at festivals. Up next, a single mother with four children and good credit sues for 10k when her stepfather reneges on a car deal. She is left with payments for 2 vehicles and a dwindling credit score.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Six years of peace and harmony between divorcees come to an abrupt halt when three ATVs and a $58,000 truck are at stake.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: When a young man is caught cheating three times, he is expelled from school. His steadfast father reverses charges for his son's tuition and is now faced with a lawsuit by administration for doing so.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: When neighbors feud over property and attorney fees, the Judge shares her own personal story about a neighbor who refused to amicably resolve an easement issue.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Costume Wars and Elder Abuse Accusation
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, an online influencer seeks the 10K court maximum from a tailor he claims botched the creation of his dream costume. The 'ill-fitting' ensemble is modelled in court by its disgruntled owner. Up next, a caregiver takes $400 from a 90-year-old dementia patient because 'she told me to.' After her patient suffers a fall, she is dismissed.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: To avoid points on his driving record, a trucker offers cash to a fellow motorist after an accident. Their arrangement falls apart when repair estimate amounts and dates vary wildly.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Baby Horse Rejection and Bad Bug Paint Job
programme.desc: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman makes a deposit on a foal six months before its birth but wants out of the contract once the animal is born. Believing the baby horse could not be insured, she sues for breach of contract. In the second case, a disabled veteran sues for a $6500 refund when the paint job on her beloved 1969 VW Volkswagen starts 'bubbling'.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A man is sued for property damage to a $1400 a month pool house with no indoor plumbing. He claims his landlord assaulted him in a fight over unpaid utilities and disrespect.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Go Fund Me Memorial Dispute and Passed Out Behind the Wheel
programme.desc: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, after a popular medical student tragically drowns, his friends raise over 40K in his honor. His mother and sister fight over his property and the funds collected. Next, a woman denies being under the influence of anything other than Benadryl when she slams into a parked car and pushes it 25 feet down a sidewalk. She is sued for damages.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: An ex-con's fresh start with his wife in a new home is marred by their landlords' lawsuit over property damage, unpaid rent and defamation. A missing claw-foot tub comes into play.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Mother and Son Fallout and Crypto Controversy
programme.desc: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a mother and son are no longer on speaking terms after a deal to purchase a van falls apart. He claims the inoperable van was a gift and that any discussion of money was only to appease her after the fact. In the next case, a mechanical engineer and a programmer fight over profits from their shared cryptocurrency mining business.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A not-so-neighborly dog walk results in vandalism and police intervention. A woman sues for a false arrest, lawyer fees and damages caused by the trauma of a night in jail.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Meet the Truth! and Loan Shark Sticker Shock
programme.desc: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a man changes his story many times when asked to prove that monies loaned to him by an ex were never meant to be paid back. In the next case, following their break-up, a man loans the mother of his child 10K to escape the burden of 500-800% interest rates on her personal debt. They fight over payback when a new boyfriend comes into play.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Both parties seek the 10K court maximum when a real-estate purchase 10 miles south of the border goes awry. A new homeowner is accused of illegally evicting the previous owner and extorting her for money by holding her pets as ransom.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a victim of a hit-and-run makes the split-second decision to slam her car into a house instead of oncoming traffic. Her actions may have saved lives, but she is sued for property damage by a homeowner. Up next, an alcohol-fueled altercation over a cheating girlfriend leaves friends at odds over an alleged assault and two kayaks.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Two large dogs set their sights on a 38-foot, inflatable, obstacle course and chew into a portion of the structure. Business partners seek compensation for damages to their party rental equipment.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: You Totaled my Car! and Gambling Girlfriends
programme.desc: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a 21-year-old drives her guardian's car without permission, crashes and totals the vehicle leaving family members to fight over damages. Up next, former gambling buddies fight over a jackpot win, missing jewelry and a little white lie to a boyfriend about where the grocery money went.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Cash Clash and Sip n' See Dispute
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, both parties seek the 10K court maximum when old friends fight over an RV escalates into a physical assault. Up next, new parents hire an event planner to organize a Sip n' See celebration of their newborn child. The planner backs out when jealousy and threats surface; she is sued for a refund.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Bad blood between unwed parents leads to a fight over a three-year-old car accident and an attempt to collect far more than the car is worth. Jail time, alleged domestic violence and admitted drug use come into play.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In a small Idaho farming community, a teenager sells four piglets to a neighbor and expects to be paid in full. The buyer claims all four animals died and that he owes nothing.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: An unlikely friendship develops between a male nurse and a female inmate through a prison pen pal program. Soon after her release, their once-supportive relationship devolves into a fight over stimulus checks and a car loan.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: What Not to Teach Your Teenager and Padding the Bill?
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, despite eye-witness testimony, a man insists that his unlicensed girlfriend was not driving his truck when it backed into a neighbor's house. His teenage son backs up his story. Next, a mechanic refuses to return a woman's wrecked car until he is paid; she admits to spending insurance money intended for car repairs on her own personal expenses.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A senior victim of bank fraud seeks restitution from her teenage, great granddaughter who made the mistake of accepting mysterious checks from an ex-con relative.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Teenagers who met in foster care get into a catfight over a boy. Their fight escalates into an aggressive act of caught-on-tape vandalism, an arrest and a 10K lawsuit.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Love Triangle Drama and Halloween Party Gone Wrong
programme.desc: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. First, a young woman breaks up with her live-in boyfriend and starts to date their new roommate. The ex-boyfriend sues the happy new couple for $10K and for the return of his two cats. Next, business partners pay $6K to rent a party space for teens; they sue for breach of contract when event restrictions are put in place without their approval.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A man is sued for alleged failure to pay his late mother's caregiver. He accuses the healthcare worker of contributing to the 'delinquency of an elderly patient' by giving his dying mother cigarettes and marijuana.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A 14-year-old girl steals her mother's car, goes on a joyride and T-bones an unsuspecting motorist on her way to work. The teenager runs from the crash site; the injured motorist leaves in an ambulance.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Teen Party Flood Damage and Inheritance Damages
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. Up first, while attending a friend's birthday party, a teenager accidentally breaks an outdoor sprinkler. Her actions, caught on security footage, cause $9K in flooding throughout an apartment building. In the next case, after inheriting her late brother's home, a woman triples the rent on his remaining tenant and sues him for alleged property damage.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In this two-part episode, a woman who suffered abuse as a child is convinced her neighbor is guilty of neglect and reports her to DCS multiple times.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In part two, the Judge must decide if a woman's allegations are justified as feuding neighbors sue for the 10k court maximum over an alleged assault and shocking charges of child endangerment.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Former army buddies pool their resources to purchase one luxury vehicle in order to start a car rental business. A doomed rental ends with the vehicle being wrecked, their insurance being dropped and thousands in damage.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A young widow with a newborn baby claims her deceased husband’s best friend stole money from his account. The best friend defends his actions passionately and says the money went to a GoFundMe set up for his children.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: To make ends meet, young parents decide to sell their pets. They immediately regret their decision and fight for the return of one of their dogs.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: To compensate for lost playing time during Covid, a devoted father pays a basketball coach $8500 to start up a team for his son. He sues for damages when the team falls apart.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A man claims he was falsely arrested after a road rage incident in which he was accused of wielding a gun. The victim of his alleged fury submits her frantic 911 call claiming a gunshot can be heard in the background.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A battle of bad online reviews is waged in rural Michigan between a pet daycare business and a water supply company.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. Up next, "Dulce" the Goldendoodle puppy suffers a broken leg while in the care of a new dog sitter who is accused of leaving the pet alone with a child.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Estranged parents fight over their teenager's cell phone, sporting events and a trip to Portugal.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In this two-part episode, a woman does her boss a favor by dropping off lunch to her home only to be attacked by her pit bull the moment she steps through the doorway. The terrifying attack is caught on video.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In part two, after a pit-bull attack, the dog's owner insists that the victim was given fair warning and told not to enter the home.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: While riding a scooter together, a man and his son are hit by a truck and thrown to the ground; the father sues the driver for damages but soon finds himself in the hot seat over his handling of the scooter.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: After a failed attempt at living together, sisters fight over property damage and the alleged theft of over $14k from their grandmother's inheritance.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Baby Bird Fatality and Dedicated Grandmother: Delinquent Father
programme.desc: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a German Shepherd digs under a fence, enters a neighbor's house and kills their baby Macaw. The Judge is appalled by how he treats the woman raising his 12-year-old child.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A youth baseball umpire sues for the $10K court maximum after being violently attacked by a coach whose team was disqualified for fielding illegal players. The umpire's son stepped in to defend his father, only to become the target of an attack by angry parents.

programme.title: Judy Justice

programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, after four weeks of dating, a woman is persuaded to invest $10K in a car-flipping venture. programme.title: Judy Justice

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In this two-part episode, a disabled veteran turned music entrepreneur sues one of 'Atlanta’s top performers’ for the $10K court maximum.

A clash takes place between the two young men; but the behaviour of Nicola, who defends Gaetano from the commissioner Ajossa who has caught them duelling, gives rise to a deep friendship between the two. Lucia, Gaetano's woman, feels attracted to Nicola, but the two repress their desire. Ajossa wants to get his hands on Gaetano and sets a trap for Lucia, inducing her to yield to him in order to save her lover, so that the latter, in order to avenge the offence, will make a mistake.

programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: Kill Zone 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A Hong Kong cop named Kit busts a major gangster only to find his cover blown and his main witness gone. The gangster, in retaliation, has him kidnapped and put in a Thai jail with a false criminal identity. Lowly prison guard Chai, with his extraordinary fighting skills, guards Kit and prevents his escape. The prison guard’s daughter suffers from a rare form of leukemia and Kit is the only donor who can save her. The prison guard discovers Kit’s real identity and helps him to escape in return for his agreeing to save his daughter. Together, Kit and Chai must face and take down the gangster and his minions.

As the trial goes on, it becomes more obvious that the murder had been meticulously planned out and carried out.

programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 6

programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 7

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 8

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 9
programme.desc: Realizing Gae Ttong is in danger because of his father, Hoon agrees to arrange her marriage to Soo. Meanwhile, Flower Crew begins the difficult task of transforming Gae Ttong into a proper noble lady.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 10
programme.desc: Gae Ttong continues her training to become a noble lady. Joon helps Lady Yim and realizes his memories of his mother were wrong. Meanwhile, the Chief State Councillor discovers that Soo has been deceiving him.

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 11

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 12

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 13

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
programme.sub-title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency episode 14

programme.title: Flower Crew: Joseon Marriage Agency
